name: Rage
description: Enter as a Bonus Action if you aren't wearing Heavy armor. While raging: Resistance to Bludgeoning, Piercing, and Slashing damage; +2 bonus to Strength-based attack damage; Advantage on Strength checks and saves; you can't maintain Concentration or cast spells. Lasts until the end of your next turn unless extended by attacking, forcing a save, or a Bonus Action — up to 10 minutes. Regain one use on a Short Rest, all on a Long Rest.
